this_court: The Tenth Circuit holds that what makes someone an "unlawful user" under § 922(g)(3) turns on the legal status of the drug used, and it declines to depart from its sister circuits.
quote: Indeed, every circuit to address the issue, albeit mostly in a cursory fashion, has held that what renders someone an “unlawful user” turns on the legal status of the drug.
cite: United States v. Davey, No. 24-3132 (10th Cir. 2025)
